shared_elements: low relief carving on a horizontal rectangular panel
quadruped animals in profile (lion / feline, bovine, horse)
lion attacking or engaged with another animal
procession-like frieze running left to right
figures with beards and headdresses in profile
justification: Both are horizontal low-relief friezes with strict profile human figures and quadrupeds, and both include the specific motif of a lion in combat with another animal, plus bearded profile heads with headgear. But A shows a static ceremonial procession of standing tribute-bearers set against architecture (columns, stairways, parapets), while B shows a dynamic hunt with a wheeled chariot, galloping horses and drawn bows — no chariot or motion in A, no architecture in B.
